in_marathi.name: Sonam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sonam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sonam is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sonit-Pur' which means a place filled with gold. Sonam is a beautiful and elegant name for a baby girl that signifies wealth, prosperity and grace.
